title: cheilanthes afra
intro: Cheilanthes afra, commonly known as the prayer plant, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Pteridaceae family and native to South Africa. This plant is valued for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, as well as its use as an antibacterial and anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Cheilanthes afra are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids. Research has identified the bioactive constituents of Cheilanthes afra, including flavonoids like quercetin and kaempferol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
